alt: 孩子快速翻過課本，腦中只留下葉子、陽光與水滴等零散圖像，沒有把知識的關係弄清楚。
scene_prompt: 囫圇吞棗 means taking information in superficially without analyzing or understanding. Use a modern STUDY metaphor, NOT a child swallowing whole fruit. At a desk a child rapidly flips through a large illustrated science book, looking pleased at how fast the pages turn but not examining the diagrams. A subtle pencil thought bubble shows disconnected simple puzzle pieces from those same science diagrams floating unassembled, clearly showing information has not been understood or connected. A small magnifying glass lies unused beside the book. Pages contain only diagrams of a leaf, roots, sun and water drops, NO writing or numerals. Focus on superficial speed vs unprocessed understanding, not reading diligently or being unable to read. No food, no choking scene.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
